testcase.name: technical stage failure returns only selected fallback cleans once and emits one safe record()

selected fallback failure is propagated once and still emits one record()
successful selected ML Kit page is the single association pass with no fallback()
association failure reuses completed selected ML Kit page and performs fallback cleanup()
successful page records actual stages worker timings counts and overlapping total()
disabled route stays lazy and emits no experimental diagnostic()
fallback time is included in monotonic total and cleanup callback failures stay isolated()
